note: IMAGE OVERRIDES — reviewed by eye, since no automatic source is reliable for every product. TCGplayer catalogue shots are usually clean single-unit photos, but some are CASE or MULTIPACK images (a 4-box shot for a single ETB misrepresents what a buyer receives). Seller photos are single-unit but are phone snapshots. Rule: a MISSING photo beats a MISLEADING one.

rules.neverShow: any image depicting a different quantity than the product being priced

xy12-etb.reason: TCGplayer catalogue image shows FOUR elite trainer boxes; this SKU is one box (Tyler, 2026-08-22)
